## Detailed Service Catalog & Deliverables

### 1. Web Development & Full-Stack Engineering
- **Technologies**: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, SSR, SSG), React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Redis.
- **Deliverables**: Ultra-fast corporate websites, responsive SaaS platforms, client portals, custom APIs, progressive web apps (PWA), and custom content management systems.
- **Speed Standard**: Sub-1-second mobile load time, 95+ Google Lighthouse performance scores.

### 2. Mobile App Development
- **Platforms**: Native iOS (Swift), Native Android (Kotlin), and Cross-Platform (React Native, Flutter).
- **Features**: Real-time push notifications, biometric authentication, offline data sync, 1-click UPI payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and automated App Store & Google Play Store release.

### 3. Enterprise AI Solutions, Smart Chatbots & Automations
- **Capabilities**: Conversational AI customer support agents, OpenAI GPT-4o / Gemini 1.5 Pro integrations, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge engines, automated WhatsApp business bots, lead qualification pipelines, and automatic GST billing systems.

### 4. Digital Marketing, Performance Ads & Growth Hacking
- **Channels**: Google Search Ads (High-Intent PPC), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram conversion funnels), LinkedIn B2B lead generation, and YouTube video promotions.
- **Attribution**: Transparent conversion tracking, GA4 event pipelines, Meta CAPI integration, and ROI reporting.

### 5. Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Local SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)
- **SEO Specialties**: Bhopal & Central India Local SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP) 3-pack optimization, citation building, technical JSON-LD structured schema markup, and Answer Engine Optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

### 6. Custom ERP, CRM & Business Management Software
- **Modules**: Lead capture CRM, stock & inventory trackers, multi-branch POS billing, automated GST invoicing, role-based staff permissions, and real-time executive reporting dashboards.

### 7. E-Commerce Development & Online Stores
- **Features**: Custom online store development, 1-click checkout, automated shipping integrations (Shiprocket, Delhivery), OTP cash-on-delivery verification, and WhatsApp catalog synchronization.

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps & Cybersecurity
- **Cloud Providers**: AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, Lambda), DigitalOcean, Vercel, Cloudflare CDN.
- **Security**: 99.9% uptime SLA, SSL certificate management, DDoS protection, daily automated backups, server hardening, and vulnerability assessments.

### 9. UI/UX Design & Brand Identity
- **Deliverables**: Figma high-fidelity prototypes, interactive wireframes, WCAG accessibility-compliant design systems, custom vector logos, and complete corporate stationery guides.
